Role / Position: Head of Mariupol Occupation Administration

Notes on Role: Led Mariupol administration under Sablin group influence. Managed metal scrap extraction from industrial enterprises through Kadyrov-linked criminal networks. Dismissed when FSB formally took control of DPR and Kiriyenko influence grew. Fate uncertain — document reports poisoning, circumstances disputed.

Role / Position: Chairman of Mariupol City Council

Former MVS career gave him security service background useful to occupation. Organised elections under Russian scenario as Morgun adviser. Targeted by partisan attack September 2024 — confirms active resistance to named collaborators in Mariupol. Confirmed in United Russia membership database (entry ~153-155).

Role / Position: Former Deputy Head of Mariupol Administration; Head of United Russia and People's Front structures in Mariupol

Also appears in HUMINT appendix as entry 23 (Дмитриев Александр Владимирович — same person, transliteration variant).

Role / Position: Adviser to Head of Mariupol Administration / Deputy Head of Administration

Role / Position: Russian State Duma Deputy; Key power broker and patron for Mariupol occupation network
Career Before: Duma deputy 4th-6th convocations from 2003; senator for Moscow Oblast 2013-2016; returned as deputy 2016. First deputy head of Boyevoye Bratstvo veterans organisation. Deputy chair of Duma defence committee. Coordinator of Duma group for DPR/LPR.
Links to Other Officials: Ivanov Petro (co-organiser Russian Spring 2014, close associate); Kharmyshev Evgeny (close); Morgun Oleg (patron, protected after fall); Ivashchenko (former client, now removed); Koltsov Anton (new administration — losing influence).
Links to Russian State Bodies: United Russia; State Duma defence committee; Boyevoye Bratstvo; BARS Kaskad drone unit (joined 2022).
Business / Economic Connections: 20% stake in Vyna Arpachyna winery. Net worth Forbes top-100 Russia: 168m roubles 2020, 402m 2021. Co-founder of Antimaydan ultraconservative movement.
Military Connections: Voluntarily joined BARS Kaskad drone unit 2022 — commanded operations near Mariupol and Zaporizhzhia Oblast. Hero of Russia 2024. Awarded Order of Courage.
Notes on Role: Born in Mariupol, uses "local patriot" identity. One of the principal organizers of Russian Spring 2014 alongside Petro Ivanov. Personally oversaw ER humanitarian centres in Mariupol 2022-2023. Led group pushing for Mariupol's direct financial subordination to Moscow (bypassing Donetsk) — opposed by Pushilin/FSB group. His group (Sablin group) lost the power struggle after the referendum. Attended first school bell at Mariupol School No. 65 in September 2022 carrying a pistol — caused scandal. Sanctioned US, EU, UK, Canada, New Zealand, Ukraine for supporting annexation and fraudulent referendums. As of June 2025 protecting Morgun from criminal prosecution.

Role / Position: Criminal authority / informal power broker in Mariupol
Career Before: Former Mariupol city council deputy (Party of Regions). Co-organiser of pro-Russian rallies and Russian Spring 2014 with Sablin. Financed separatist initiatives. Had status of de-facto "smotryashchiy" (overseer) for Mariupol in 2014.

Notes on Role: Identified as criminal authority controlling organised crime in Mariupol under occupation. Former city council deputy who transitioned to informal power broker role. Coordinated all activity in Mariupol from Russia 2022-2023 including reconstruction management. Currently has limited but sufficient influence for key decisions. His connection to Sablin predates 2014. Document notes he "retains entrepreneurial and administrative base" in Mariupol.

Role / Position: Head of GUP DPR 'Administration of the Sea Port of the City of Mariupol'

Links to Russian State Bodies: GUP DPR (state unitary enterprise); DPR Ministry of Transport (supervising body).
